description: Implementation of DefaultDeviceStateManager class handling device state events and messaging within Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DefaultDeviceStateManager
classes.description: Manages device state events and communicates with core services, handling device connect, activity, disconnect, inactivity, and timeout updates.

methods.name: onDeviceConnect
methods.description: Handles device connection event, forwarding to local service or sending message to core.

methods.name: onDeviceActivity
methods.description: Handles device activity event, forwarding to local service or sending message to core.

methods.name: onDeviceDisconnect
methods.description: Handles device disconnection event, forwarding to local service or sending message to core.

methods.name: onDeviceInactivity
methods.description: Handles device inactivity event, forwarding to local service or sending message to core.

methods.name: onDeviceInactivityTimeoutUpdate
methods.description: Updates device inactivity timeout, forwarding to local service or sending message to core.

methods.name: forwardToDeviceStateService
methods.description: Internal method to route device events either locally or via cluster messaging based on partition and service availability.
